title: Path Sum II
statement: Return every root-to-leaf path whose values add up to targetSum, each path listed from root to leaf. Paths may be returned in any order.

hints.1_question: This is Path Sum with the actual paths collected. What do you need to remember as you walk down and then back up?
hints.2_nudge: Keep a single running `path` list: append on the way down, record a COPY at a qualifying leaf, and pop on the way back up.
hints.3_big_hint: dfs(n, rem): append n.val; if leaf and n.val == rem: res.append(path[:]); recurse on children with rem - n.val; path.pop().

known_bugs.name: stores the live path list (not a copy)
known_bugs.followup: After the DFS finishes, what is in `path`? What do the lists you stored point to?

known_bugs.name: accepts paths that stop at a non-leaf
known_bugs.followup: A valid path must end at a leaf. Does yours?

known_bugs.name: returns only the first path found
known_bugs.followup: The task asks for every matching path. How many matching paths are in [1, 2, 2] with target 3?

followups: Why is copying the path at a leaf necessary?
